data.name: subtitle_connected

data.name: servers_subtitle
data.value: Incomplete list, due to how VPNGate works

data.name: no_servers
data.value: No servers. Click Update to refresh the VPNGate list.

data.name: volunteer_disclaimer
data.value: Some servers may be offline because these are volunteer-operated public VPN servers.

data.name: error_auth_failed
data.value: The server asked for an account and refused the VPNGate vpn/vpn account. Choose another server.

data.name: error_openvpn_missing
data.value: OpenVPN 2.6 is not installed. Install it from the Home tab, then try again.

data.name: error_driver_missing
data.value: No usable VPN network adapter (TAP-Windows6 / Wintun / ovpn-dco). Reinstall OpenVPN with its drivers.

data.name: error_service_missing
data.value: The OpenVPN Interactive Service is not running. Reinstall OpenVPN from the Home tab or start the service "OpenVPNServiceInteractive".

data.name: error_connection_lost
data.value: The VPN connection was lost. Connect again or choose another server.

data.name: error_load_servers_timeout
data.value: Timed out loading VPNGate servers. Check your connection and click Update.

data.name: connect_timeout_message
data.value: Could not connect to {0} within {1} seconds. The server may be overloaded or blocked on your network. Try connecting via another server.

data.name: connect_timeout_no_other
data.value: No other server available. Refresh the server list and try again.

data.name: openvpn_card_body
data.value: STG Phantom VPN uses the official OpenVPN Community 2.6 client and its network drivers (TAP-Windows6, Wintun, ovpn-dco). The installer is downloaded from openvpn.net and checked with SHA-256 before it runs.

data.name: install_download_failed
data.value: Download failed. Check your Internet connection and try again.

data.name: install_hash_mismatch
data.value: The downloaded installer did not match the expected SHA-256 and was deleted.

data.name: install_msi_failed
data.value: The installer did not finish. Try again or install manually.

data.name: install_uac_declined
data.value: Administrator permission was not granted, so nothing was installed.

data.name: allow_local_lan_summary
data.value: When on, devices on your local network (printers, NAS, etc.) remain reachable while the VPN is connected. Applied on the next connect.

data.name: block_dns_summary
data.value: Prevents DNS leaks while connected. Turn off if websites stop resolving on some servers.

data.name: vpn_engine_body
data.value: Uses the official OpenVPN Community 2.6 client through the OpenVPN Interactive Service, so the app runs without administrator rights. VPNGate profiles are filtered before use: script, plugin, management and file directives are removed, and OpenVPN runs with --script-security 1 on the TAP-Windows6 adapter.

data.name: privacy_note_body
data.value: VPNGate servers are public VPNs. Do not use for sensitive traffic. Traffic may be logged by public VPN operators.

data.name: credit_openvpn
data.value: Uses OpenVPN® Community 2.6 (GPLv2), installed from openvpn.net. Source: github.com/OpenVPN/openvpn/tree/v2.6.23

data.name: credit_flags
data.value: Country flags: flag-icons by Panayiotis Lipiridis (MIT)

data.name: feedback_hint
data.value: Click to send feedback by email

data.name: tap_body_missing
data.value: OpenVPN is installed, but the TAP-Windows6 network driver that VPNGate servers need is missing. STG Phantom VPN can add it from the official OpenVPN {0} installer, which is checked with SHA-256 and the OpenVPN Inc. signature before it runs. Windows will ask for administrator permission once.

data.name: tap_body_create
data.value: The TAP-Windows6 driver is installed, but there is no TAP-Windows6 network adapter. STG Phantom VPN can create one with OpenVPN's signed tapctl tool. Windows will ask for administrator permission once.

data.name: tap_body_inactive
data.value: A TAP-Windows6 network adapter exists but is disabled or unavailable. Enable it in Control Panel > Network Connections, or let STG Phantom VPN create a new adapter. Windows will ask for administrator permission once.

data.name: tap_confirm_question
data.value: Allow STG Phantom VPN to install it now?

data.name: tap_later_note
data.value: If you choose Not now, nothing is installed and the app asks again only when you connect to a VPNGate server.

data.name: tap_ready_body
data.value: The driver and network adapter are installed. You can connect now.

data.name: tap_still_missing
data.value: TAP-Windows6 is still not available. Restart Windows and try again. If it persists, open Settings > Apps > OpenVPN > Modify, enable TAP-Windows6, and check the log.

data.name: install_openvpn_newer
data.value: A newer OpenVPN is already installed, so the bundled installer cannot change it. Open Settings > Apps > OpenVPN > Modify, enable TAP-Windows6, then try again.

data.name: prereq_body
data.value: OpenVPN cannot be installed or used on this PC until the Microsoft updates below are installed. Install them, restart Windows, then press Check again.

data.name: prereq_kb2999226
data.value: Universal C Runtime, needed by OpenVPN and OpenSSL.

data.name: prereq_kb4474419
data.value: SHA-2 code signing support, needed to load the TAP-Windows6 network driver.

data.name: prereq_kb4019990
data.value: D3DCompiler_47, needed by .NET Framework 4.8 on Windows 7.

data.name: prereq_roots_missing
data.value: These root certificates are not in the Windows certificate store yet: {0}. Windows usually downloads them automatically when first needed. If a download or connection fails with a certificate error, install the latest root certificate update from Windows Update and try again.

data.name: prereq_roots_policy
data.value: Automatic root certificate updates are turned off by policy on this PC, so these certificates have to be installed manually.

data.name: prereq_still_missing
data.value: Still missing: {0}. Some updates only take effect after Windows restarts.

data.name: prereq_all_ok
data.value: All required Windows updates are installed.

data.name: prereq_blocked_notice
data.value: Install the required Windows updates before using OpenVPN.

data.name: tray_hint_title
data.value: STG Phantom VPN is still running

data.name: tray_hint_body
data.value: The app keeps running in the notification area and your VPN stays connected. Click the icon to open it, or right-click it and choose Exit to quit.

data.name: exit_confirm_body
data.value: The VPN is still connected. Disconnect and exit STG Phantom VPN?

data.name: minimize_to_tray
data.value: Minimize to the system tray when closing

data.name: minimize_to_tray_summary
data.value: Closing the window keeps the app and the VPN running in the notification area. Turn off to quit when the window is closed.

data.name: dns_summary
data.value: Choose who answers DNS lookups while the VPN is on. A public resolver can be faster or filter ads and malware.

data.name: dns_server_default_detail
data.value: Uses the DNS the VPNGate server provides

data.name: dns_invalid
data.value: Not a valid public IPv4 address, for example 1.1.1.1. Private and local addresses cannot be used.

data.name: dns_custom_required
data.value: Enter a primary DNS. Until then the server's DNS is used.

data.name: dns_block_note
data.value: With your own DNS, DNS outside the tunnel is always blocked so lookups cannot leak.

data.name: settings_apply_next
data.value: Connected: the new connection settings apply the next time you connect.

data.name: credit_dns
data.value: DNS provider logos: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS (Cisco) and AdGuard are trademarks of their owners.

data.name: error_server_refused
data.value: Server {0} refused the connection (AUTH_FAILED). This is a VPNGate server-side problem (overloaded or out of addresses), not your password or settings. Choose another server.

data.name: connect_timeout_message_network
data.value: No response from server {0} within {1} seconds. The server may be offline or overloaded, or its port is blocked on your network. Try another server.

data.name: connect_timeout_message_handshake
data.value: Server {0} answered but did not finish setting up the session within {1} seconds. It may be overloaded. Try another server.

data.name: connect_timeout_message_adapter
data.value: Connected to server {0}, but the TAP adapter did not get an IP address within {1} seconds. Try another server; if this happens with every server, open the logs and check the TAP-Windows6 driver.

data.name: log_truncated
data.value: Large file: only the last {0} is shown. Open the log folder to see all of it.

data.name: log_read_failed
data.value: Could not read the log file: {0}

data.name: block_ipv6_summary
data.value: VPNGate is IPv4 only. When on, all IPv6 connections are blocked while the VPN is connected so your real IP cannot leak over IPv6; removed on disconnect or app exit. Bridged sessions use a Windows Firewall (WFP) block, which asks for administrator rights (UAC) once per app run.

data.name: ip_check_failed
data.value: Could not check the IP (offline or the check services did not answer).

data.name: ip_status_not_tunneled
data.value: VPN IP equals the real IP: traffic is not going through the VPN.

data.name: ip_status_v6_leak
data.value: IPv6 leak: {0} is still reachable outside the VPN. Disconnect and connect again.

data.name: ip_status_v6_leak_off
data.value: IPv6 leak: {0} bypasses the VPN. Turn on "Block IPv6 leaks" in Settings.

data.name: ip_status_ok_server
data.value: Traffic goes through the VPN (matches the server IP), no IPv6 leak.

data.name: ip_status_ok
data.value: Traffic goes through the VPN (differs from the real IP), no IPv6 leak.

data.name: log_clear_confirm
data.value: Delete all app and OpenVPN logs? This cannot be undone.

data.name: log_clear_active_note
data.value: The log of the running connection is emptied instead of deleted.

data.name: logs_section_summary
data.value: App and OpenVPN logs stay on this PC and help find out why a connection failed.
